extraction.text:
Ishwar Raman

Mobile: +91-9060675367 | Email: ishwarraman@gmail.com | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ishwar-raman-968621107/

Professional Summary

10+ years of expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, and Cloud technologies with a strong focus on enterprise software development and technical leadership.

Proficient in designing, developing, and deploying scalable, high-performance applications using Java 8, J2EE, Hibernate, Kafka, AWS, and Angular.

Strong experience in microservices architecture, API design, and full-stack development.

Proven ability to lead and mentor engineering teams, drive agile development, and implement best coding practices.

Expertise in design patterns (Singleton, Abstract Factory, Builder, Facade) for writing maintainable and modular code.

Passionate about system performance optimization, cloud adoption strategies, and CI/CD automation.

Adept at working in fast-paced environments, delivering high-quality software solutions, and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders.

Professional Experience

Technical Lead | Xiaomi Technology India Pvt. Ltd.

Sept 2021 – Present

Spearheading the development of MI Smart, a portal managing sales and employee records for offline and partner stores.

Led an 8-member team in designing and deploying Spring Boot-based microservices with Redis, RabbitMQ, and MySQL.

Provided technical leadership, conducting code reviews, mentoring junior engineers, and ensuring adherence to best practices.

Architected highly available and fault-tolerant solutions for sales operations across thousands of stores.

Awarded Best Employee (MI Superhero) – 2022 and Global Recognition (MIT, Beijing) – 2023 for contributions to software innovation.

Technical Lead | Torry Harris Business Solutions, Bangalore

Dec 2016 – Sept 2021

Led a 12-member team for Exide Self Service, a customer portal for policy management and digital transactions.



Designed and implemented microservices and SOAP web services in Java 8, Spring Boot, Angular, and MySQL.

Improved system scalability and reliability, reducing downtime by 30% through effective caching and API optimization.

Defined agile development processes, improved CI/CD pipelines, and enhanced security in API interactions.

Software Engineer | Wissen Infotech, Bangalore

March 2016 – Nov 2016

Developed DMS (Warehouse Management System) for Landmark Group, enhancing inventory tracking and order processing.

Optimized REST APIs and Spring Boot applications, leading to a 20% performance improvement.

Assistant Consultant | Genisys Software, Bangalore

April 2014 – March 2016

Contributed to Ecosystem, a dealer and order management system for SmartEquip, U.S..

Developed JSP-based interfaces, integrated Spring DAO with Hibernate, and improved system responsiveness.

Technical Skills

Programming Languages: Java 8+, J2EE, JavaScript, TypeScript

Frameworks & Libraries: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Hibernate, Angular, JPA

Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, CI/CD Pipelines Web Technologies: RESTful APIs, SOAP, HTML, CSS

Databases: MySQL, Oracle, Redis

Tools & Platforms: Git, Maven, Log4j, JUnit, RabbitMQ, Kafka

Education

Master of Computer Applications (MCA) | IGNOU, New Delhi



Key Achievements & Awards

Best Employee (MI Superhero) – 2022

Employee of the Year (MI Superhero) – 2022

Global Recognition Award (MIT, Beijing) – 2023

Successfully led the migration of legacy monolithic applications to microservices- based architecture, reducing deployment time by 40%.

Projects

MI Smart (Xiaomi, India)

Tech Stack: Java 8, Spring Boot, Microservices, Redis, RabbitMQ, MySQL, Docker

Led the development and deployment of critical sales and inventory management systems.

Designed high-availability microservices handling millions of transactions monthly.

Exide Self Service (Exide, India)

Tech Stack: Java 8, Angular, Spring Boot, MySQL, GitLab CI/CD

Architected the platform to improve customer self-service efficiency, leading to a

25% increase in digital transactions.

Enhanced security using JWT-based authentication.

MIP (Milvik)

Tech Stack: Java, JSP, Spring, Hibernate, SOAP Web Services

Developed core insurance microservices, supporting millions of daily transactions.

Leadership & Team Management

Successfully managed engineering teams of 8-12 members in agile environments.

Conducted technical mentoring, fostering a culture of innovation and quality.

Led code reviews, architecture discussions, and CI/CD improvements.

Additional Information



Open to Engineering Manager / Java Technical Lead roles.

Strong advocate of clean code, system scalability, and cloud-first development.
